label_definition: union of the provided CARRADA dense segmentation masks, restricted to the detector-valid interior; annotation-empty frames kept as all-background examples; nothing invented
input_adapter: carrada_input.to_tinycnn_magnitude then the frozen dl.dataset.normalize_rd (= D - median(D), clipped [-10,+60] dB, /20)
supervision_change: extended real object masks, NOT the synthetic flat 3x3 point labels. This is real-domain adaptation, not a continuation of the original point-target task.
pos_weight_rule: round(N_neg / N_pos) over the 15 FIT sequences inside the valid interior, capped at 100; cap and reason declared before computing

synthetic_reference.note: the synthetic label was a 3x3 block around a point target; CARRADA masks are extended, so the positive density is far higher and the ratio far lower
